Was the viet cong bad?  Yes.  Was how we attacked right? No.


Jason Rantz on Seattle Red (@jasonrantz)

But Chris, this is not what “imminent threat” means in the context of Article 2.



— https://nitter.net/jasonrantz/status/2035383733562573229#m

There is no mention of the word or the idea in art 2. That is a canard. This is not merely abt why trump is doing this but HOW it is being done and what that means in middle east and at home. Those are legit concerns regardless of what regime threat warrants


Jason Rantz on Seattle Red (@jasonrantz)

But Chris, this is not what “imminent threat” means in the context of Article 2.



— https://nitter.net/jasonrantz/status/2035383733562573229#m

Why play games? IMMINENT threat. Everyone knows the regime is toxic. Just like saddam was. But you guys lied to drive urgency. Just like now.


Ari Fleischer (@AriFleischer)

Iran just fired two missies at a target 4000 kilometers away.  London is 4400 kilometers from Tehran. 

Tell me Iran is not a threat to the world. 

(Paris, Rome, Vienna and Berlin are closer…)



— https://nitter.net/AriFleischer/status/2035195795113206091#m

Action without philosophy is often wasted


Temenos (@javierp31415313)

You adopted the tactic of hiding behind pseudo philosophical questions - we dont need to know, we need to act. The idea of predicting the future as a necessity for action is the position only the privileged can take. If Iranians are happy, you should take their lead



— https://nitter.net/javierp31415313/status/2035102322502840542#m

Me? Yes. And I would preference regenerative soil operations and treat processing agents as poisons


RiskyDave (@RiskyDave)

The cost doesn't matter poison is poison.

Do you ban glyphosate or not?



— https://nitter.net/RiskyDave/status/2035027459519738044#m

No, I do not. But we are seeing more extreme talk and action thanks to social media


Janette Klein (@jkdestin)

What happened to being a “Fair Broker”, Chris?
So you believe America is “close to” THIS?:

People suck...in general, and this platform features the worst of us. Max was excellent and persians must lead the charge vs regime!


Melody (@MelodyOCLA)

Dude - people leaving ignorant comments — seriously ? A person comes to speak about Persians and Iranians in a beautiful way and people have to criticize them like he doesn’t know what he’s talking about because he’s a comedian? He is still Persian raised by Persian parents.



— https://nitter.net/MelodyOCLA/status/2035185308283940950#m

America is nothing like the regime...the world is safer without extreme Islamism. And the shooting  of the 2 citizens and the arrest of the man below and Georgia fort are closer to what the regime is about than what America is supposed to be


Defiant L’s (@DefiantLs)

Don Lemon: "We are saying that Iran shoots protesters. Well, so do we ... that makes us no better than them

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/DefiantLs/status/2035159460940062814#m

Something does not make sense about this war in Iran. We already won says the president but what is winning here? And who and what is losing out at home?
